text: Okay, like I said, my brain's not working! I don't have any emails in front of me, and I can't remember the domain name either. It's just gone! And transferring me doesn't help, I need this fixed now. Like, my address is wrong, and I need that t-shirt! Can't you just look at my recent orders? I know I ordered something not too long ago. That's how I know the address is wrong! Can't you just use that? And what's the cheapest t-shirt you got? Can you get that for me?
zh: 好的，就像我说的，我脑子不转了！我现在面前没有邮件，也记不住域名。它就是没了！而且转给我也不行，我现在就需要解决。比如，我的地址错了，我需要那件T恤！你不能直接看看我最近的订单吗？我知道我最近订过东西。我就是知道地址错了！你不能用那个吗？还有，你们最便宜的T恤是什么？你能帮我拿一件吗 (#W1234567, #I789012, T恤)
